title: Greetings at Home
subject: English Language
objectives: Greet your parents politely at home
Respond to questions about family members

blocks.alt: A child greeting his parents in a living room
blocks.caption: Ayo greets his parents when he wakes up.

blocks.md: When you wake up in the morning, it is polite to greet your parents. You can call your father **'Dad'** and your mother **'Mum'** or **'Mummy'**.

lines.speaker: Mr. Adebayo
lines.text: Good morning, Ayo. Did you sleep well?

lines.speaker: Ayo
lines.text: Yes, dad, I slept well. Thank you. Good morning, mummy.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Adebayo
lines.text: Good morning my dear. Is Kunle still sleeping?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Adebayo
lines.text: Please, go and find out from his room.

blocks.md: **Remember:** Always greet your parents when you wake up. It shows respect and love.

quiz.q: How does Ayo greet his father?
quiz.explain: Ayo wakes up and says 'Good morning, dad'.

quiz.q: What does Mrs. Adebayo ask Ayo to do?
options: Find out if Kunle is sleeping
quiz.explain: She asks him to go and find out from Kunle's room.
Mrs. Adebayo asks if Kunle is still sleeping, implying he is Ayo's brother.
